source: Paper official GitHub repo tos-1/NezNet; VIPERS PDR2 public data policy.
safe_sample_definition: zflg <= 14 and zspec > 0 (robust approx of paper's 96.1% confidence; paper uses zflg=1 precisely)
note: Paper W4 test is a random ~2e4 subset; this card uses the full official match table, so sigma is ~11% higher and outlier +0.9 pt (same order). Model-improvement numbers (sigma 0.04, outlier 0.8%, ~75%) require NezNet weights not present in the frozen packet.
